These modules generate “ripstop” artifacts that harden a repository’s agent guardrails and make them auditable. One module emits a merge-ready Claude Code settings fragment that denies edits to key policy files, preventing self-weakening automation. The other module renders the human-facing RIPSTOP.md from a resolved configuration, embedding metadata and a config hash for freshness checks, and can adapt output for different AI tools’ preferred formats.

```mermaid
C4Component
title Ripstop guardrails generation (TypeScript directory)

%% Components in this directory
Component(claudeDenySettings, "claudeDenySettings.ts", "TS Module", "Builds merge-ready Claude settings JSON fragment with permissions.deny rules.")
Component(markdown, "markdown.ts", "TS Module", "Generates RIPSTOP.md from resolved config; embeds metadata and config hash; supports multiple output formats.")

%% External dependency
Component_Ext(ripstopSchema, "IRipstopConfig (../config/schema)", "TypeScript Types/Schema", "Resolved ripstop configuration (enabled checks, bypass trailer settings).")

%% Outputs / external systems (conceptual)
System_Ext(claudeCode, "Claude Code Settings Merge", "Merges .claude/settings.ripstop.json into .claude/settings.json and enforces permissions.")
System_Ext(repoFiles, "Repository Filesystem", "Stores generated artifacts such as RIPSTOP.md and .claude/settings.ripstop.json.")

Rel(markdown, ripstopSchema, "Reads resolved configuration shape", "Type reference")
Rel(markdown, repoFiles, "Emits generated RIPSTOP.md content", "Write")
Rel(claudeDenySettings, repoFiles, "Emits .claude/settings.ripstop.json content", "Write")
Rel(claudeDenySettings, claudeCode, "Provides deny rules consumed during settings merge/enforcement", "JSON")
```

Key components: markdown.ts is the primary renderer for RIPSTOP.md. It consumes the resolved IRipstopConfig shape, converts enabled checks into a readable “what this repo blocks” section, and embeds generation metadata (time, package version) plus a SHA-256 config hash. It also provides extractEmbeddedConfigHash() and a regex constant to detect freshness. It can rewrite/wrap output for tool-specific formats (Claude, Cursor, Codex, Amazon Q). claudeDenySettings.ts outputs a minimal JSON fragment that denies edits/writes to guardrail-defining files (RIPSTOP.md, .guardrails/, and Claude settings), intended for Claude Code’s settings merge and enforcement.
